name: Chemical Engineering
notes: A 2.0 minimum GPA is required in core courses to remain in the program.

The humanities/social science requirement is one cluster PLUS two courses in the OPPOSITE division from the chosen cluster (20 credits total). The app cannot tie the two extra courses to the division you did not cluster in, so they are modeled as any humanities or social science courses - check the opposite-division rule yourself.
PHYS 113 replaces PHYS 121 only for students in the MATH 141 series; the 121P/122P variants are alternate sections of the same courses. Neither is modeled as a separate option.
Upper-level writing is covered inside CHE 246 and CHE 255, which are already required core courses, so the only separate writing course is WRTG 273.
The advanced chemistry elective is modeled as any 200-level or higher CHEM course.
Two technical electives may be any engineering or natural science course.

requirementGroups.label: Required chemical engineering courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Required Chemical Engineering Courses: CHE113: Chemical Process Analysis; CHE 116: Numerical Methods and Statistics; CHE243: Fluid Dynamics; CHE225: Thermodynamics I; CHE 226: Thermodynamics II; CHE244: Heat and Mass Transfer; CHE231: Kinetics and Reactor Design; CHE250: Separation Processes; CHE246: Laboratory in CHE Principles; CHE279: Chemical Engineering Practice; CHE273: CHE Process Design and Simulation; CHE255: CHE Senior Design Lab; CHE272: CHE Process Control

requirementGroups.label: Foundational chemistry
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Chemistry: CHEM131: Chemical Concepts I; CHEM132: Chemical Concepts II; CHEM203: Organic Chemistry I; CHEM207: Organic Chemistry Lab; CHEM204: Organic Chemistry II

requirementGroups.label: Mathematics
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Math: MATH161: Calculus I (or MTH 141); MATH162: Calculus II (or MTH 142-143); MATH164: Multidimensional Calculus; MATH165: Linear Algebra and Differential Equations

requirementGroups.label: Physics
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Physics: PHYS121 or 121P: Mechanics (or PHYS 113 for students in MATH 141-series); PHYS122 or 122P: Electricity and Magnetism

requirementGroups.label: Introduction to Sustainable Energy
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Electives: CHE150: Introduction to Sustainable Energy

requirementGroups.label: Technical electives (2)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Two technical electives (any engineering or natural science course)

requirementGroups.label: Humanities/social science beyond the cluster (2)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: One humanities or social science cluster plus two courses in the opposite division of the chosen cluster (20 credits total)
requirementGroups.note: The opposite-division constraint is not auto-enforced.

upperLevelWriting.label: WRTG 273 plus writing inside CHE 246 and CHE 255
